method: code reading (scene3d.py _TRUONG, quantity_annotations, scene3d-view renderer, geometry samples) + goal probes (semantic_to_scene_gap_matrix.json) + independent invariant checks (scene3d_mathematical_invariants.json)

object_types.ray: NOT_SUPPORTED as a scene type (angle arms are drawn as segments)
object_types.plane: SUPPORTED (plane3, measurement-only planes hidden by default)
object_types.height / altitude: SUPPORTED with an exact perpendicular_witness when the source gives it (SA ⟂ base, projection foot); PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED for a face ⟂ base (volume correct, altitude not drawn)
object_types.median / centroid: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: centroid is composed (midpoint + divide_segment) when named; medians are not scene objects of their own; unnamed centroid refused
object_types.diagonal: SUPPORTED (segments, intersection O for regular pyramids)
object_types.projection: SUPPORTED: point onto line (named, project_onto), point onto plane (distance witness, named foot, NEW line-plane angle foot)
object_types.intersection line of two planes: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: kernel + section steps exist; the local parser does not read 'Xác định giao tuyến …' (probe intersection_planes)
object_types.section: PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED: kernel and scene ('section' objects, geometry samples) exist; the local parser refused both section probes
